Olga / Sara —

Quick legal note on signature authority and minimal evidence we need to accept a delegated signer:

- If the individual who will sign is an officer listed on the corporate records (CEO, CFO, COO), no additional POA is required — just match name/email to corporate directory.
- If signing is by an authorized delegate, BlueWave must provide either: (a) a signed POA on company letterhead naming the delegate and authority to sign this agreement, or (b) a certified board resolution. The POA/resolution must be received by Redwood Legal before countersignature.

Regarding the redlines, legal has reviewed and we're comfortable accepting the majority; there are three limited commercial items outstanding (SLA uptime credit formula, data retention clause minor language, and Order Form payment milestone). If BlueWave can confirm those items in one short email, we can proceed with final packaging.

DocuSign logistics: single envelope (MSA + Order Form) is fine. Recommended signing order is: 1) BlueWave signers 2) Redwood counter-sign (Markus). No witness required in our standard flow. If BlueWave requires a two-signer witness, call that out now.

Attachment: signature_authority_requirements.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Envelope ID (internal): EX-998877-OLGA
